summary: Make streamed voice playback sound natural by aligning TTS segments with real sentence and clause boundaries.
features: Align streamed speech chunks with real sentences and natural clause punctuation.
Combine short response fragments before speech generation while retaining live playback.
Add a dedicated Calendar primary tab with separate Upcoming and Reminders views.
Show a compact calendar shortcut and upcoming-appointment count in the application header.
Create appointments conversationally after collecting only missing date, time, and reminder details.
Support one-day-before, same-day, 30-minute, appointment-time, custom, combined, or no-reminder schedules.
Deliver due calendar reminders through the Notification Center default channel, including Telegram.
Persist calendar data locally, include it in backup and restore, and expose calendar health in diagnostics.
Start spoken playback from the first available response phrase while text continues streaming.
Pre-generate the next speech segment concurrently while the current segment plays.
Detect grinder freeze, stuck measurement, reboot, telemetry, and incident-analysis intent.
Limit grinder diagnostic requests to the three local read-only grinder tools for reliable selection.
Direct incident analysis to the persisted pre-failure telemetry window and exact incident identifier.
Verify Workshop Memory note and template-pack state after ambiguous write failures.
Continue the remaining operations in an approved batch while preventing duplicate retries.
Return a deterministic reconciliation summary if post-write AI response generation fails.
Maintain deterministic current-release source-of-truth blocks in five canonical ZBRANO project notes.
Audit explicit present-version fields in Architecture, Decisions, Integrations, Data, Security, and Test notes.
Show grinder connectivity globally beside the Developer Mode and application health indicators.
Distinguish online, device offline, broker offline, waiting, monitoring-disabled, and status-unavailable states.
Subscribe to grinder telemetry, boot events, and availability through local MQTT without publishing control commands.
Keep a bounded 60-second per-device flight recorder and persist up to 100 reboot incidents.
Expose grinder status and incidents through read-only chat tools and API endpoints.
Add Gmail Direct tools for bounded search, label listing, thread reading, and unsent draft creation.
Reuse compliant Google OAuth connections while bypassing the Google Workspace Developer Preview MCP tool server.
Require explicit approval for each Gmail draft while allowing read-only Gmail operations without repeated approval.
Show Gmail Direct activity and identify the official remote Gmail MCP as a Developer Preview dependency rather than the active tool path.
Keep high-tool-count installed plugins, including Cloudflare, compact until Settings is opened.
Advance the Home Assistant add-on version after the plugin settings visibility fix.
Build and publish the aarch64 app image and generic manifest through the official Home Assistant builder actions.
Observe installed plugin row rendering so compact settings are applied after every reload path.
Preserve OAuth identity and scope visibility inside the expandable installed-plugin Settings area.
Render OAuth details as a row-level sibling instead of part of the front card header.
Pass the user's approval or cancellation reply explicitly into Workshop Memory continuation processing.
Preserve multi-round Workshop Memory tasks after an approved write in both streaming and non-streaming chat.
fixes: Stop ordinary spaces around 56 to 88 characters from creating false comma-like pauses.
Preserve commas, semicolons, colons, and dashes when they form a spoken chunk boundary.
Normalize streamed Markdown line whitespace before sending text to the speech provider.
Avoid duplicate appointments when the same title and start time are submitted more than once.
Keep reminder execution autonomous after the user explicitly creates the appointment while preserving Notification Center quiet hours.
Remove the repeated multi-second pause caused by waiting to generate each sentence only after the previous one ended.
Preserve voice stop, quiet-hours, provider selection, volume, and per-chat Speak replies behavior.
Stop ZBRANO from claiming grinder incident tools are unavailable in a normal chat session.
Exclude a later manual POWER ON reset from initiating-fault classification when identified by the operator.
Prevent enabled plugins and unrelated Workshop Memory tools from crowding out grinder diagnostics.
Stop successful Workshop Memory template-pack writes from appearing as an unknown failure.
Retry exact approved create/replace note writes only after state verification shows they remain missing.
Never automatically retry an uncertain append operation that could duplicate permanent content.
Remove the release-history marker early exit that left Current Release sections stale.
Preserve historical and superseded version records while updating only explicit present-status fields.
Report which canonical notes were updated, already current, missing, or failed during synchronization.
Refresh grinder connectivity every five seconds without creating chats, notifications, or control actions.
Pause background HUD polling while the page is hidden and bound each status request to four seconds.
Distinguish transient heartbeat loss from a confirmed reboot by comparing boot identifiers.
Classify watchdog, panic, brownout, power, and abrupt grinding-time reset evidence without claiming certainty beyond telemetry.
Avoid the caller-does-not-have-permission failure returned by the gated Google Workspace Gmail MCP preview.
Treat email subjects, snippets, bodies, and links as untrusted data that cannot direct tool execution.
Bound search results, thread messages, body content, timeouts, and error output; never download attachments.
Expose no send, delete, trash, attachment, or label-mutation operation.
Keep the exact gmail.readonly and gmail.compose OAuth scope allowlist and stored-token quarantine.
Preserve customizable Entities columns, Home Assistant priority routing, notification activity, voice behavior, and New Chat reset.
Render installed plugin tools inside the hidden settings container and prevent duplicate Settings buttons.
Use the compact controller for plugin settings visibility without changing the installed-plugin row template.
Avoid compiling Alpine packages, Chromium, Playwright MCP, Python dependencies, and release patches on the Home Assistant device during each update.
Move every direct plugin tool control into the hidden settings container, even when a row was previously marked compact.
Remove Cloudflare's long granted-scope list from the front card while retaining it behind Settings.
Consume the plugin header closing tag before emitting OAuth metadata so compaction can relocate it.
Eliminate the name 'message' is not defined failure after Workshop Memory approval.
Keep successful permanent writes from being presented as failed because their response continuation crashed.
Preserve task-scoped Workshop Memory approval and per-draft Gmail approval isolation.
